About us

Your local taxi company in Kotor & Tivat

Safe, punctual and comfortable transportation around the Bay of Kotor and across Montenegro.

RED TAXI

Red Taxi is a taxi and transfer company from Kotor, serving the whole of Kotor and Tivat municipalities. We drive locals, visitors and business guests every day — from short city rides to airport transfers and full-day excursions.

Our goal is simple: a safe, high-quality and punctual service, with a car that arrives when you need it and a driver who knows the way.

Operating areas

Kotor and Tivat

We run two dispatch lines — 19719 for Kotor Municipality and 19729 for Tivat Municipality — so the nearest car can reach you quickly. Transfers and excursions take you anywhere in Montenegro and to Dubrovnik in Croatia.
